ai_summary: Godfrey Phillips India Limited is initiating the regulatory-mandated transfer of equity shares and associated unclaimed dividends (from FY 2018-19 onwards) to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority. Affected shareholders have until October 29, 2026, to claim their outstanding dividends; failure to do so will result in their shares being transferred, necessitating a separate, potentially complex process to reclaim them from the IEPF. While this is a standard compliance action for the company, it highlights a segment of disengaged shareholders whose investments are at risk of being moved out of their direct control.
